geometry.deliveryCoordinateSystem: EPSG:4326 (longitude, latitude), requested explicitly from the service
geometry.processing: The service GeoJSON response is retained byte-for-byte. No tracing, redrawing, simplification, rounding, clipping, ring removal or invented geometry. The service performs the requested coordinate transformation.

fields.objectid: Service feature identifier; may change when the service is republished.
fields.lga_code: Queensland source local-government code, not an ABS LGA code.
fields.ca_area_sqkm: Source polygon area in square kilometres, which may include marine extent; do not substitute for land-area indicators.

specialAreas.name: Weipa Town
specialAreas.note: Retain and label this separate town-authority area. It is the 78th source polygon, in addition to the 77 councils. Do not mislabel it as an ordinary council or delete its geography.

displayRules: Render the supplied actual polygon geometry on Canvas. Do not replace it with invented SVG outlines or illustrative shapes.
Preserve holes, islands and multipolygon parts in drawing and hit testing.
All 77 councils and the separately labelled Weipa Town area must be searchable and selectable.
Only Redland City has a built P4A local journey in this pass; other selections must not imply completed local portals.
This is a dated navigation display, not an official boundary determination or address eligibility service. Link users to ECQ for official electoral enquiries.
refreshRules: Check the ECQ boundary and review pages, then the Queensland Government catalogue and source layer before replacement.
Download the full current source query with outSR=4326. The service changed its native CRS to EPSG:3857 on 26 June 2026; do not assume native coordinates are longitude and latitude.

Validate feature names, unique source codes, geometry types, non-empty coordinates, ring closure and count; distinguish any new or changed area before altering the expected 77-plus-Weipa classification.
Retain the raw response, update its byte count and SHA-256, and record the retrieval date, catalogue update date, processing and attribution separately.
Regenerate the local delivery bundle and verify map selection, search, holes, islands, Redland navigation, source links and small-screen controls.
Do not advance source review dates simply because a page or bundle was regenerated.
